data.message: Now with all that being said, would it be possible to get an update to the mod so that it does increase the damage for the weapons listed that at this point are not affected, ie the bows, crossbow, slingshot, rifle and revolver, pretty please?

After some testing with console commands to show damage numbers I can positively say that the Damage Multiplier in this mod does not work for Crafted Bows, Compound Bow, Crossbow, and Slingshot. From my testing is does increase the damage for melee weapons, the pistol, and the shotgun. It does not increase damage for the rifle or the revolver.
Which weapons do the Damage Multiplier apply to? Melee, Bows, Crossbow, Guns, or all?
Is anyone there? I want to know how to fly. Thank you.
